ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
A mouse wants to escape a labyrinth. On her way out she is only allowed to go through each opening once at most. How many different ways can the mouse choose to go to get outside?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, there is a maze made of curved wall lines, and the mouse is inside the enclosed area on the far left. The maze extends from left to right, and the adjacent gaps at the black dots indicate passable openings. At the far right there is a final exit leading to the outside. The overall structure can be regarded as two main passages, upper and lower, with one connection in the middle that allows switching between the upper and lower passages. Reasoning: According to the method, build the maze into a graph: each region is regarded as a vertex, each opening is regarded as an edge, and each edge is used at most once. Starting from the left region where the mouse is located, there are first two choices: take the upper-left opening, or take the lower-left opening. After reaching the middle, if starting from above, one can continue along the upper passage to the right-side exit, or can switch through the middle connection to the lower passage and then reach the right-side exit; if starting from below, similarly one can continue along the lower passage, or can switch through the middle connection to the upper passage. In this way, four route patterns that do not reuse openings are obtained: enter upper exit upper, enter upper exit lower, enter lower exit upper, enter lower exit lower. If other branches try to loop back, they will lead to reusing an opening or cannot form a new route leading to the far-right exit. Therefore there are 4 ways.

raw_record.question_text: A mouse wants to escape a labyrinth. On her way out she is only allowed to go through each opening once at most. How many different ways can the mouse choose to go to get outside?

method.method_draft: Model the labyrinth as a graph and count edge-simple paths. First read the diagram: the mouse starts in the leftmost chamber, the outside is reached through the final opening at the far right, and the black-dot gaps between curved wall segments are the openings. Label each chamber/region between openings as a vertex and each opening as an edge. From the left chamber, trace all possible routes toward the right while marking any opening already used; whenever a partial route would have to reuse a marked opening or goes into a dead end, stop that branch. The valid route patterns are: upper-left branch continuing through the upper route, upper-left branch crossing through the middle to the lower route, lower-left branch crossing through the middle to the upper route, and lower-left branch continuing through the lower route. These four edge-simple routes reach the far-right outside opening, so the count is 4.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一座由弯曲墙线组成的迷宫，老鼠在最左侧的封闭区域内。迷宫从左到右展开，黑色圆点处的相邻缺口表示可以通过的 opening。最右端有一个通向外部的最后出口。整体结构可以看成上下两条主要通路，中间有一次可以在上、下通路之间转换的连接。

推理：按方法把迷宫建成图：每个区域看作顶点，每个 opening 看作边，并且每条边最多使用一次。从老鼠所在的左侧区域出发，首先有两种选择：走左侧上方 opening，或走左侧下方 opening。之后到中部时，如果从上方开始，可以继续沿上方通路到右侧出口，也可以通过中间连接切换到下方通路再到右侧出口；如果从下方开始，同理可以继续沿下方通路，也可以通过中间连接切换到上方通路。这样得到四种不重复使用 opening 的路线模式：上进上出、上进下出、下进上出、下进下出。其他分支若尝试绕回会导致重复使用 opening 或不能形成新的通向最右出口的路线。因此共有 4 种方式。
